dsDescriptionValue.value: This data consists of more than 4K data samples of power consumed by the conveyor belt motor driver. This data is collected from FASTory Assembly Line. During data collection, belt tension and load on the conveyor belt (the number of pallets residing on the conveyor belt) varies from zero to maximum. This data describes how belt tension and load on the conveyor affect the power consumption of the conveyor belt motor driver. This data is used to develop a prognostic model which takes power consumed by the conveyor belt motor driver and load on the conveyor and predicts belt tension class and alerts users when belt tension deviates from optimal class. For more information contact, mahboob.elahi@tui.fi
